name: Clash-Xiaoy v2.7.20
body:
# ✨ Update: UI Simplification & Experimental Cleanup

## 🧹 Removed Experimental UI

* Completely removed the `experimental` UI system
* Deleted `src/pages/(experimental)` and all related pages:

  * Dashboard
  * Proxy
  * Profiles
  * Rules
  * Settings
* Removed all related routing to prevent invalid navigation

## 🔘 Removed Experimental Entry

* Removed "Switch to Experimental UI" button from settings
* Deleted `ExperimentalSwitch` component (TSX & JSX)
* Cleaned up:

  * `useNavigate` usage
  * `setEnabledExperimentalRouter` references

> The UI now only exposes stable and supported features.

---

## 🎨 UI Redesign (Windows-style)

Refactored the overall interface to align with a cleaner, native desktop experience:

### Removed Effects

* Removed `cyber-glass`, glow, and neon effects
* Removed motion/animation classes:

  * `animate-float`
  * `ios-motion`
* Removed decorative visual noise (scanlines, glow layers)

### Updated Layout & Components

* Simplified sidebar layout and spacing
* Updated navigation buttons:

  * Removed glow effects
  * Added subtle hover transitions
* Refined main content container:

  * Cleaner background & borders
  * Improved visual hierarchy
* Updated top bar to a card-style layout

---

## 🧩 Design Adjustments

* Unified border radius:

  * Main layout container now uses `border-radius: 9px`
* Increased logo size:

  * Updated to `h-28 w-28` for better visibility
* Improved spacing and padding consistency

---

## ✅ Result

* Cleaner and more maintainable codebase
* Fully stable routing (no dead links)
* More consistent and minimal UI
* Improved usability and readability
* Better alignment with native Windows design language

---

## ⚠️ Notes

* Experimental UI is **no longer available**
* Future updates will focus on stability and core features

---

## 🚀 Status

Frontend is now fully functional and ready for daily use.
